instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: We all want to value the time we spend learning, but even when we want the same thing, a wrong choice can cost each of us different things. We also have different amounts of responsibility to take on. One bag cannot hold everyone's idea of what is good. There is power to decide how money is spent. There is power to shape the classroom, and there is the duty to keep daily life going. Even people with little say in decisions have burdens just as heavy. What they need to protect may matter deeply. Still, they may not get to take part in the decision. Before we close the bag, are we shutting out even the acceptance someone has not yet found the words to express?
